### 4. Scored parameters (formula in words, inputs, tiers, value)

**(a) Late balance charge** — computation doc "Late Balance Charge Computation" (baseline) + factor docs found from the records:
- Clock start ("Late-Charge Clock Start…", found from the financing account's funded_date 2026-07-28 after completion 07-23): "for a contract paid by Ridgeline financing whose lender funding posted after the installation completion date, the clock starts on the lender funding date" → 2026-07-28; "late-charge start date is reckoned from the clock start by adding the series final-balance due days" (5, "Deposit, Card and Final Balance Figures") → 2026-08-02.
- Grace ("Payment Grace for Financed Window Contracts", from `autopay_enrolled: True`): "10 days … when the Ridgeline financing account on the contract has autopay enrolled" → +10.
- Goodwill ("Company-Delay Goodwill…", from reschedule `initiated_by: 'company'` and ship_date = committed_ship_date): "7 days … when only one of those two happened" → +7. Start date 2026-08-19.
- Full periods to 2026-10-13: 55 days → 1 full period (ended 2026-09-18); no late balance charge entry on the ledger → 1 uncharged.
- Late-charge balance: "signed contract price plus the change-order lines less the price credits, less the payments received net of refunds; fees … bear no late charge" = 14896 + 4356 − 0 − 16731.60 = 2520.40.
- Account standing ("Financing Account Standing…", from finance txns: no late fee/returned payment, one payment posted 09-21): "clean-paying share of 0.5".
- Catch-up ("Catch-Up Rate on Overdue Late Periods"): first uncharged period ended 2026-09-18; 25 days to the day figured → "at least 15 days … and no more than 30 takes the aging-period share of 0.75".
- Late-rate amount = 0.015 × 2520.40 × 0.5 × 0.75 = 14.17725 → 14.18.
- Period amount ("Minimum Late Charge While Work Is Owed", from 2 open punch items and the part_on_order visit under this contract's registration): "while Ridgeline still owes work … the period amount is the late-rate amount alone, with no minimum" → 14.18.
- Charge = 14.18 × 1 = **14.18**. Fall-back (baseline doc only): due date 2026-07-28, 77 days → 2 periods × max(0.015×2520.40 = 37.81, 15.00) = **75.62** (definite, different).

**(b) Change-order fee** — customer change orders by date: 05-18, 05-22, 05-28 (oversize line excluded, "Customer Change Orders on Window Contracts"); 3300 free count 2 ("Change-Order Allowances…") → the 05-28 change order is beyond the free count and is the latest. Series fee $85.

- Fee = 105 × 1.25 × 1.5 × 1.25 × 1.25 × 0.5 = 153.80859 → **153.81**, dated **2026-05-28**. Fall-back: **85.00**.

**(c) Remeasure fee** — customer-requested remeasures 05-20 and 05-27 (company remeasure 05-26 not counted, "Measure Visit Standards" cl. 7); 3300 free remeasure count 1 → 05-27 is beyond it and is the latest completed. Series remeasure fee $135, missed-appointment fee $85.
